_intraday_amendments.why: NOT a full rebuild -- the brief still owns this trading day and its structure stands. But its REGIME LABEL, measured in the first three minutes of the session, is now demonstrably WRONG, and leaving an actively false regime read in the file for the next instance is worse than the cost of correcting it. The stated intraday-shock triggers were technically not met (VIX FELL rather than rising 15%; QQQ 713.62 is still 0.64 above its 50d 712.98 and well above the 20d 706.24 that the brief names as the real level; AVGO 358.63 is still fractionally above its named 357.80 structural level) -- so this is a correction of the record, not a shock rebuild.

_intraday_amendments.implication: Sharpens rather than reverses the brief's original conclusion. A 5-6% single-name drawdown that produces ZERO vol response is the strongest evidence yet that long premium has no tailwind in either direction here. The desk's two open puts benefit on DELTA today and get nothing from vega. For new entries the read is unchanged and stronger: do not buy premium into a market that will not re-rate vol, and note that every expression of today's actual move is barred by the 2-of-2 short-tech theme cap regardless.
